faqs.a:
Section 912.2. Location,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"912.2. Location.
With respect to hydrants, driveways, buildings and landscaping, fire department connections
                  shall be so located that fire apparatus and hose connected to supply the system will
                  not obstruct access to the buildings for other fire apparatus. The fire department
                  connection for automatic sprinkler systems and standpipe systems shall be located
                  a minimum of 50 feet and a maximum 150 feet (45,720 mm) of a fire hydrant."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
